description: A small stack of colorful plastic plates and utensils sits on the left side of a wooden table, with a green plate in the middle, a yellow squeeze bottle to the right, and a blue sponge near the right hand. The left hand steadies and lifts a blue spoon above the green plate while the right hand sets the yellow bottle down and then wipes the spoon with the blue sponge, rubbing along the handle and bowl before lowering the spoon back toward the plate and moving on to wipe a green utensil.
